comments.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>Posting ChatGPT links isn't enough. You need to include a pdf of the interaction trace that includes the entire prompt together with your annotations and critical commentary on what it is doing. It's too bad that the popular chatbots haven't seem to converged on a comment format that is stripped from the input/context that the LLM sees. </paragraph></document>
